<div class="ts-root">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/apps/shared/timestamp-player/player.css?v=3">

<style>
/* player.css is tuned for a reveal.js slide, where everything scales with the
   deck. This is an ordinary page, so the component is given a base size of its
   own -- and the clock the size the thing is named for. */
.btp { font-size: 1.25rem; margin: 1.5rem 0 1.5rem; }
/* the big clock, in a part of its own (clock-panel.js moves it out of the Player) */
.ts-bigclock { text-align: center; }
.ts-bigclock .btp-clock {
  font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; user-select: all;
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 11vw, 7rem);
}
.ts-bigclock .btp-clock.idle { opacity: 0.35; }
#ts-clock > summary .ts-clock-float { margin-left: auto; font-size: .75rem; padding: .05rem .5rem; }
#ts-clock.is-floating { position: fixed; z-index: 1050; width: min(360px, 90vw); background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }
#ts-clock.is-floating > summary { cursor: move; }
#ts-clock.is-floating .btp-clock { font-size: 4rem; }
.btp .btp-stage,
.btp .btp-drop,
.btp .btp-bar { max-width: 900px; }
.btp-howto { margin: .25rem 0 0; font-size: .95rem; color: #6c757d; }
/* the whole width, as the Backing Track has it */
.ts-root { max-width: 1500px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 1rem; }
/* hidden parts leave the page (page-nav.js); the × in each header hides, the list on the right shows */
.ts-panel.ts-hidden { display: none !important; }
.ts-hide { margin-left: auto; border: 0; background: none; color: #6c757d; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1; padding: 0 .3rem; cursor: pointer; }
.ts-hide:hover { color: #b02a37; }
.ts-panel > summary, .ts-panel > .ts-fold-h { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; cursor: pointer; }
/* the fold triangle (page-nav.js folds; .ts-fold-h parts draw theirs in player-log.css) */
.ts-panel > summary::before { content: "\25B8"; display: inline-block; color: #6c757d; font-size: .8em; transition: transform .15s; }
.ts-panel[open] > summary::before { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.ts-panel > summary { list-style: none; } .ts-panel > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.ts-nav li { display: flex; align-items: center; }
.ts-nav li a { flex: 1; }
.ts-eye { border: 0; background: none; color: #6c757d; padding: 0 .35rem; cursor: pointer; font-size: .9rem; }
.ts-eye:hover { color: inherit; }
.tsn-lib-rows { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: .4rem 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .25rem; max-height: 50vh; overflow-y: auto; }
.tsn-lib-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .15rem .3rem; border-radius: .3rem; }
.tsn-lib-row.is-cur { background: #eef4ff; }
.tsn-lib-name { flex: 1; font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.tsn-lib-what { color: #6c757d; font-size: .85em; }
.tsn-lib-row button { font-size: .8rem; padding: 0 .4rem; }
.ts-help { margin: 2rem 0 1rem; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: .4rem; padding: .4rem .8rem; }
.ts-help > summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; }
.ts-i { display: inline-block; width: 1.2em; height: 1.2em; line-height: 1.15em; text-align: center; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: .9em; margin-right: .3em; }
</style>

<div class="btp-layout">

<div class="btp-main">

<details class="btp-fold ts-panel" id="ts-clock" data-nav="Clock" open>
<summary><h2>Clock</h2><button type="button" class="ts-clock-float" title="Float it over the page, to drag anywhere">Float</button></summary>
<div class="ts-bigclock"></div>
</details>

<details class="btp-fold ts-panel" id="ts-notation" data-nav="Notation" open>
<summary><h2>Notation</h2></summary>
<p class="ts-nt-note btp-log-note" data-help-eye="off"></p>
<div class="ts-nt-paper" style="max-height:60vh;overflow:auto"></div>
</details>

<details class="btp-fold ts-panel" id="ts-player" data-nav="Player" open>
<summary><h2>Player</h2></summary>
<div class="btp">
  <div class="btp-clock idle" data-num-edit="off">00:00</div>
  <div class="btp-stage" hidden></div>
  <div class="btp-drop">Drop a video or audio file here</div>
  <div class="btp-bar">
    <input class="btp-url" type="text" placeholder="Paste a YouTube link…" spellcheck="false">
    <button class="btp-load">Load</button>
    <button class="btp-follow-btn" type="button" title="Play it in YouTube's own tab and keep the clock here">Follow in a tab</button>
    <label class="btp-filebtn">Choose file<input class="btp-file" type="file" accept="video/*,audio/*"></label>
  </div>
  <div class="btp-err"></div>
</div>
</details>

<section class="btp-live" aria-label="Now playing">
  <details class="btp-fold ts-panel" id="ts-grid" data-nav="Chord grid" open>
    <summary><h2>Chord grid</h2></summary>
    <div class="panel-tabset btp-grid-tabset"><ul class="nav nav-tabs btp-grid-tabs" role="tablist"></ul></div>
    <div class="btp-grid-now"></div>
    <div class="btp-grid-next tune-chart" hidden><b></b><div class="btp-grid-next-bars"></div></div>
    <div class="btp-grid-row">
      <p class="btp-grid-note"></p>
      <button class="btp-correct" type="button" aria-pressed="false" title="While it plays, each bar you play chords in (right hand) is rewritten with what you play there; a bar you play through without a note keeps what it had. A pause ends the pass.">Correct chords</button>
      <button class="btp-grid-copy" type="button" title="Every timed section as ChordPro {start_of_grid} blocks">Copy as ChordPro grid</button>
      <button class="btp-confirm" type="button" hidden>Timing is right</button>
    </div>
  </details>
  <details class="btp-fold btp-live-set ts-panel" id="ts-midi" data-nav="Chord timing and MIDI">
    <summary><h2>Chord timing and MIDI</h2></summary>
    <p class="btp-log-note"><kbd>N</kbd> as each chord starts (<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>N</kbd> takes the last one back): which chord
       it is comes from the words, so only the timing matters. Or all at once from a MIDI keyboard: the <b>left hand</b> plays
       one note on every barline and two notes together where a section starts; the <b>right hand</b> plays the chords.
       Only when notes start counts, and the left hand's pitches don't matter.</p>
    <div class="btp-live-row">
      <span class="btp-log-note">The MIDI keyboard connects in the sidebar on the right.</span>
      <label>Split <input class="btp-split" type="number" min="21" max="108" value="60"> <span class="btp-split-name">C4</span></label>
      <label title="Times are moved back by this much, for hearing the recording late">Latency <input class="btp-latency" type="number" min="0" max="500" step="5" value="0"> ms</label>
      <label>Round to <select class="btp-grid"><option value="beat">the beat</option><option value="half">the half beat</option></select></label>
      <button class="btp-live-clear" type="button" title="Forget the chord timing of the section under the playhead, to play it again">Clear this section's timing</button>
      <button class="btp-correct" type="button" aria-pressed="false" title="While it plays, each bar you play chords in (right hand) is rewritten with what you play there; a bar you play through without a note keeps what it had. A pause ends the pass.">Correct chords</button>
    </div>
    <p class="btp-live-status" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </details>
</section>

<section class="btp-words">
  <details class="btp-fold ts-panel" id="ts-words" data-nav="Words and chords" open>
    <summary><h2>Words and chords</h2></summary>
    <p class="btp-log-note">Paste a song from Ultimate Guitar (chords on the line above the words, <code>[Verse 1]</code> headings)
       and Convert: the chords go into the words as ChordPro, and the headings become the sections to stamp.</p>
    <label class="btp-title-label"><span>Title</span><input class="btp-title" type="text" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Names the downloads too"></label>
    <div class="btp-word-now" aria-live="polite" hidden></div>
    <div class="btp-word-view" role="group" aria-label="Show">
      <button type="button" data-view="ug">Ultimate Guitar</button><button type="button" data-view="cho">ChordPro</button><button type="button" data-view="both">Both</button>
    </div>
    <div class="btp-word-cols">
      <textarea class="btp-ug" rows="12" spellcheck="false" aria-label="Ultimate Guitar text"
        placeholder="[Verse 1]&#10;G              D&#10;Here comes the sun"></textarea>
      <textarea class="btp-cho" rows="12" spellcheck="false" aria-label="ChordPro"
        placeholder="The ChordPro appears here; change it as you like."></textarea>
    </div>
    <div class="btp-log-buttons">
      <button class="btp-convert" type="button">Convert</button>
      <button class="btp-from-stamps" type="button" title="The section stamps' labels become the ChordPro's sections (no chords or words needed)">Sections from stamps</button>
    </div>
  </details>

  <details class="btp-fold ts-panel" id="ts-wordsecs" data-nav="Sections from the words" open>
    <summary><h2>Sections from the words</h2></summary>
    <p class="btp-log-note">While it plays, press <kbd>S</kbd> as each section starts: it stamps the next one on this list.</p>
    <ol class="btp-word-secs btp-sec-rows"></ol>
    <div class="btp-log-buttons">
      <button class="btp-stamp-next" type="button">Stamp the next section</button>
    </div>
  </details>

  <details class="btp-fold ts-panel" id="ts-send" data-nav="Send on" open>
    <summary><h2>Send on</h2></summary>
    <p class="btp-log-note">With the bars tapped, each section's chords are spread over its bars, at the tapped tempo.</p>
    <div class="btp-log-buttons">
      <button class="btp-send-notation" type="button">Notation page (melody)</button>
      <button class="btp-send-band" type="button">Backing Track (style)</button>
    </div>
    <p class="btp-send-note" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </details>
</section>

<div class="btp-barmap">
  <div class="btp-bars-now" aria-live="off"></div>

  <details class="btp-fold ts-panel" id="ts-barmap" data-nav="Bar map" open>
    <summary><h2>Bar map</h2></summary>
    <p class="btp-log-note">While it plays, press <kbd>B</kbd> on the first beat of every bar.
       <kbd>Backspace</kbd> takes back the last tap; tapping a bar again replaces it. A missed tap shows as a long bar:
       <b>Fill gaps</b> puts it in. Tapped in 4 but it's really in 2 (or the other way)? <b>Halve</b> or <b>Double</b> the bars. A bar in another meter (a 2/4 bar, a 3/4 bridge): set its <b>Beats</b> in the Bars table.</p>
    <div class="btp-log-buttons">
      <button class="btp-bars-tap" type="button">Tap a bar</button>
      <label class="btp-beats-label">Beats a bar <input class="btp-beats" type="number" min="1" max="32" value="4"></label>
      <button class="btp-bars-fill" type="button" title="Put in the bars missed between taps">Fill gaps</button>
      <button class="btp-bars-extrapolate" type="button" title="Tap a stretch (the head), stamp where each section starts (S): the rest of the bars from the tempo, each section a whole number of choruses when it is close">Fill from the tempo</button>
      <button class="btp-bars-guess-clear" type="button" title="Take out the bars put in from the tempo (your taps stay)">Clear guesses</button>
      <button class="btp-bars-clear" type="button">Clear bars</button>
    </div>
    <p class="btp-log-note btp-guess-note" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <div class="btp-log-buttons">
      <button class="btp-bars-halve" type="button" title="Split every bar in two: tapped in 4, meant in 2">Halve bars</button>
      <button class="btp-bars-double" type="button" title="Join the bars in pairs: tapped in 2, meant in 4">Double bars</button>
      <button class="btp-bars-undo" type="button" hidden>Undo</button>
    </div>
    <p class="btp-bars-warn" hidden></p>
    <p class="btp-bars-summary"></p>
  </details>

  <details class="btp-fold ts-panel" id="ts-sections" data-nav="Sections (stamped)" open>
    <summary><h2>Sections</h2></summary>
    <p class="btp-log-note">Each section stamp (<kbd>S</kbd>) starts its section on the tapped bar nearest it. Open a section for its
       choruses (a head or a solo), and a chorus for its bars. <b>&#9998;</b> beside any time corrects it: type the time and press
       Return, or press a letter (or a key on the MIDI keyboard) as the playhead reaches it; <kbd>Space</kbd> plays meanwhile,
       <kbd>&uarr;</kbd> <kbd>&darr;</kbd> nudge. <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>L</kbd> loops the section under the playhead.</p>
    <ol class="btp-sec-rows"></ol>
    <p class="btp-log-empty btp-sec-empty">No sections yet: stamp one with <kbd>S</kbd>.</p>
  </details>

  <details class="btp-fold ts-panel btp-phrases" id="ts-phrases" data-nav="Chunks" open>
    <summary><h2>Chunks</h2></summary>
    <p class="btp-log-note">Transcribe a chunk at a time. Each section is cut into chunks of a few bars; a chunk loops from its <b>lead-in</b>
       (the pickup: how many beats before its first downbeat the melody starts, up to two bars) to its <b>stop</b> (the next downbeat, or
       up to two bars later, or earlier: a beat early when the next chunk has a one-beat pickup).
       <kbd>P</kbd> loops the chunk under the playhead, <kbd>,</kbd> <kbd>.</kbd> the one before or after,
       <kbd>-</kbd> <kbd>=</kbd> shorten or lengthen its lead-in, <kbd>{</kbd> <kbd>}</kbd> move its stop, <kbd>T</kbd> (or <b>Notate</b>) goes to it on the Notation page,
       whose <b>Back to the recording</b> loops the next one here. The Notation page cuts each section into the same chunks (V1a, V1b ...),
       and <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Space</kbd> there plays this recording from the note being written. Slow it down with the player's speed.
       Open the song file on the Notation page to loop and record chunks there, without this page.</p>
    <div class="btp-log-buttons">
      <label class="btp-beats-label">Bars a chunk <select class="btp-ph-size"><option>2</option><option selected>4</option><option>8</option></select></label>
      <label class="btp-beats-label" title="Listen: the recording. Play along: the recording and you, each pass a take on the Notation page. Play alone: the recording silent, a click, each pass a take. Listen, then play: the two by turns.">Loop <select class="btp-ph-mode"><option value="listen">Listen</option><option value="along">Play along</option><option value="alone">Play alone (click)</option><option value="cycle">Listen, then play</option></select></label>
      <label class="btp-beats-label"><input type="checkbox" class="btp-ph-chunks" checked> Cut the sections into these chunks on the Notation page</label>
    </div>
    <ol class="btp-ph-rows"></ol>
    <p class="btp-log-empty btp-ph-empty">No chunks yet: tap the bars and stamp the sections.</p>
    <p class="btp-ph-note btp-send-note" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </details>

  <details class="btp-fold ts-panel" id="ts-library" data-nav="Saved songs">
<summary><h2>Saved songs</h2></summary>
<p class="btp-log-note">Every recording's notes (stamps, bars, words and chords, chord timing, chunks) are kept in this browser as you work.
   Load a different recording and the one before is put away; load one you have worked on and its notes come back. Download them now
   and then: the browser can lose them. <b>Open file</b> in Timestamps reads a downloaded set back in.</p>
<ul class="tsn-lib-rows"></ul>
<p class="btp-log-empty tsn-lib-empty">Nothing saved yet.</p>
<div class="btp-log-buttons">
  <button class="tsn-lib-dl-all" type="button" title="The ticked songs, or every song when none is ticked, in one .json">Download all (or ticked)</button>
  <button class="tsn-lib-del-picked" type="button">Delete ticked</button>
  <button class="tsn-lib-clear" type="button" title="Every saved song but the one on the page">Delete all others</button>
</div>
</details>
<details class="btp-fold ts-panel" id="ts-bars" data-nav="Bars">
    <summary><h2>Bars</h2></summary>
    <p class="btp-log-note">The chords of each confirmed section, a cell a beat (<code>.</code> holds the chord on): the same as the
       grids written into the ChordPro at each pause, where they can be changed by hand.</p>
    <div class="btp-log-buttons"><button class="btp-bars-grid-copy" type="button">Copy the chord grid (ChordPro)</button></div>
    <table class="btp-bar-table">
      <thead><tr><th aria-label="Delete"></th><th>Bar</th><th>Starts</th><th>Length</th><th>BPM</th><th>Beats</th><th>Chords</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody class="btp-bar-rows"></tbody>
    </table>
  </details>
</div>

</div>

<div class="btp-splitter" role="separator" aria-orientation="vertical"
     aria-label="Resize the notes column" tabindex="0"
     title="Drag to resize · double-click to reset"></div>

      <span class="btp-live-sec"></span>
      <select class="btp-live-pick" aria-label="Go to a section" title="Go to a section"></select>
      <span class="btp-live-next"></span>

        <button type="button" class="btp-live-bigger" title="Bigger words" aria-label="Bigger words">A+</button>
        <button type="button" class="btp-live-mode" title="Float it over the page, to drag anywhere">Float</button>
      </span>

    <div class="ts-fold-body">

<section class="btp-log ts-panel" id="ts-log" data-nav="Timestamps">
  <h2 class="ts-fold-h" title="Click to fold or open">Timestamps</h2>
  <div class="ts-fold-body btp-log-body">
  <p class="btp-log-note"><kbd>S</kbd> stamps a section: choose its label (Head, Verse, Sax solo, A, A&prime;, B &hellip; or Other to type one); a label that comes again is numbered everywhere (Head 1, Head 2). <kbd>C</kbd> stamps a note. Click a time to jump to it, &times; to delete it.
     Shift+click to type a new one. <kbd>Space</kbd> or <kbd>Return</kbd> plays and pauses; <kbd>&larr;</kbd> <kbd>&rarr;</kbd> or <kbd>h</kbd> <kbd>l</kbd>
     go 5 seconds back or on. Leave a note with <kbd>Esc</kbd> or <kbd>jk</kbd>.</p>
  <label class="btp-autonote-label">
    <input class="btp-autonote" type="checkbox" checked>
    Jump to the note field after a stamp
  </label>
  <ol class="btp-log-rows"></ol>
  <p class="btp-log-empty">Nothing stamped yet.</p>
  <div class="btp-chorus-count">
    <b>Choruses</b> <label title="The bars of one chorus (the form). Left empty, it is the first Head's bars.">a chorus is
      <input class="btp-form-bars" type="number" min="1" max="256" placeholder="?"> bars</label>
    <div class="btp-choruses"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="btp-log-buttons">
    <button class="btp-stamp-now" type="button">Stamp now</button>
    <button class="btp-sort" type="button">Sort by time</button>
    <button class="btp-copy-all" type="button">Copy all</button>
    <button class="btp-clear" type="button" title="Everything for this song: stamps, bars, words and chords, chord timing, chunks. Save the song file first to keep it.">Clear all data</button>
    <button class="btp-save-cho" type="button" title="The ChordPro box with all the timing in it (x_ directives other ChordPro apps skip): words, chords, sections, bars and the link in one .cho">Save as ChordPro</button>
    <button class="btp-download" type="button" title="Everything on the page: stamps, bars, words, chords, chord timing and the link">Save song file</button>
    <label class="btp-import" title="A song file, a ChordPro (.cho, timed or not), a SALAMI chords .txt (McGill Billboard), or an older timestamps .txt or bar-map .json">Open file<input class="btp-import-file" type="file" accept=".json,.txt,.cho,.chopro,.chordpro,.crd,application/json,text/plain"></label>
    <button class="btp-paste-open" type="button">Paste…</button>
  </div>
  <div class="btp-paste" hidden>
    <textarea rows="6" spellcheck="false"
      placeholder="01:23&#9;Chorus starts&#10;02:05&#9;Key change"></textarea>
    <div class="btp-log-buttons">
      <button class="btp-paste-go" type="button">Import</button>
      <button class="btp-paste-cancel" type="button">Cancel</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  </div>
</section>

<details class="ts-help" data-help-eye="off">
<summary><span class="ts-i" aria-hidden="true">i</span> How this page works</summary>
<ol class="btp-steps">
  <li><b>Audio</b>: a YouTube link or a file.</li>
  <li><b>Words and chords</b>: paste them from Ultimate Guitar and Convert &mdash; or open a SALAMI chords file (McGill Billboard <code>salami_chords.txt</code>) with <b>Open file</b> or <b>Paste…</b> in Timestamps: its sections, bars and chords come in already timed.</li>
  <li><b>Sections, bars, chords</b>: <kbd>S</kbd> as each section starts, <kbd>B</kbd> on every downbeat, <kbd>N</kbd> on every chord change
      &mdash; or all three at once from a MIDI keyboard.</li>
  <li><b>Send on</b>: to the Notation page for the melody, or the Backing Track for a style.</li>
</ol>

<p class="btp-howto">Each part can be hidden with its &times;; the list on the right shows it again (Shift+click a name: only that part). Drag a part's &#10303; grip, or click &#8644;, to move it to the other column. <kbd>u</kbd> undoes the last change (a deleted stamp, cleared bars, anything); press it again to go further back.</p>
<p class="btp-howto">New here? <a href="/lessons/timestamp-player.html">How to map a recording</a>, step by step, including what to do when YouTube won't play a video.</p>

</details>
